topic: Principles & operations of Super chargers, description and operations
syllabus_extract: Principles & operations of Super chargers, description and operations
specific_objectives: 22.1.1.1 Trainees will be able to explain about the working principle of piston engines.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of engine supercharger diagrams; Safety: No live equipment; Supervision: Instructor monitors diagram interpretation
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a supercharger in a piston engine?
How does a supercharger differ from a turbocharger regarding power source?
Why is supercharging necessary for high-altitude flight performance?

development.content:
Working principle of piston engines
Induction system components
Atmospheric pressure effects
Air-fuel mixture requirements

Description of supercharger types
Centrifugal supercharger operation
Positive displacement supercharger operation
Drive mechanisms and gear ratios

Supercharger operational cycles
Boost pressure regulation
Heat management systems
Maintenance and inspection points

summary_questions: Explain how a centrifugal supercharger increases manifold pressure.
Describe the relationship between engine RPM and supercharger output.
Identify three critical maintenance checks for a supercharger system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the operational principles of LP 02 (Piston Engine Principles) with the supercharging mechanisms discussed in this lesson.
